Senses.Explanation: Birth-and-death is nirvana appears in the records as a complete equivalence, repeatedly paired with “afflictions are awakening.” Yongming Yanshou uses it to name concentration grounded in realizing the equivalence; Poshan Haiming places it beside “afflictions are liberation”; Xiangtian Jinian Jingxian calls the paired propositions difficult to believe; and Zhuanyu Guanheng includes it in a verse on unrestricted freedom. Across these witnesses the phrase functions as an asserted proposition rather than as a label for some separate referent or procedure.
